name: Za ushko kus'
source:
This story will tell about a guy and his passion for travel and will show a fateful meeting with a sweet, but not quite ordinary girl, and how she changed his ordinary life. Now many guys dream about cute girls with cat ears and other arrangements, even as pets, our guy turned out to be one of them,
but in this case it was the other way around.

[Translated from [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/12-1-0-227]Anivisual[/url]]
translation:
这个故事将讲述一个男人和他对旅行的热情，并将展示与一个甜蜜但不太普通的女孩的命运般的相遇，以及她如何改变他平凡的生活。现在很多男生都梦想着长着猫耳朵和其他造型的可爱女孩，甚至当宠物，我们的男生竟然就是其中之一，
但在这种情况下，情况恰恰相反。

[译自[url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/12-1-0-227]Anivis[/url]]
